description: Read-only catalog of the datasets on this server. Returns one row per dataset with `id` (the value other tools accept as `dataset`), `title`, `kind`, `tools` (number of products), `plans` (number of plans), `updated` (date of the last verified change), `page` URL and `json` endpoint on getstackversus.com, plus `generated` (build date). Currently 9 datasets: AI assistant and coding-agent plan limits, SaaS usage limits, LLM API token prices, voice-agent $/min, AI media credits, search APIs, scraping platforms and proxies, email platforms. No parameters, no auth, no pagination; the whole catalog comes back in one call. Use it once to learn dataset ids; use list_tools to see the products inside one dataset.
name: list_datasets
title: List datasets
